cover_letter.greeting: Dear Guidehouse Financial Services Advisory Team,
paragraphs: I am applying for the Financial Services Advisory Consultant role in New York. I am completing an MBA in Finance (STEM) at Fordham Gabelli, after working at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I am interested in Guidehouse because this practice works across banking, insurance and capital markets, and the job is to turn hard business problems into recommendations clients can act on.

Two parts of my background fit that. As a Consultant at JPMorgan Asset Management I worked on budget and capital allocation across marketing channels, and I analyzed underperforming initiatives and made the case to move funding toward higher-yield ones, which drove a 1.5x increase in performance metrics. At Lenovo I ran variance and sensitivity analyses and scenario models that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and I turned the findings into recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders.

I would bring that mix of analysis and stakeholder work to your client teams, from building business cases to preparing leadership presentations. My background is in finance and analytics more than regulatory compliance, and I am ready to learn that side from your team. I would welcome the chance to talk about where I can help.
